<!--
One claim per issue. The claim-card format is in claims/README.md:
https://github.com/Freedom-Jack/briefbench/blob/main/claims/README.md
A link and a short paraphrase in your own words are enough. Don't paste whole articles or long quotes.
Issues are public: no private prompts, outputs or keys.
Recording a claim doesn't mean it works. It changes the skill only if a test supports it.
-->

## Source

<!-- Link, author, and the publication date or the date you read it. -->

## The claim

<!-- One assertion, in your own words. Keep your interpretation for the sections below. -->

## Conditions

<!-- The tasks, models or hosts the source says it applies to. "Not stated" is fine. -->

## Connection to brief

<!-- Your interpretation: what it might change in the skill, and why. The skill only improves a prompt; it doesn't choose methods or do the task. -->

## Known evidence

<!-- Supporting or contrary evidence you know of, with links. "None known" is fine. -->

## Possible test

<!-- Optional. For example, the claim as a snippet or a skill variant, compared with the current skill. Leaving this open is fine. -->
